meta.subject: fixed timing issue w systolic array

en.summary: The PE now updates forwarded input and partial-sum outputs only when `start` is asserted, fixing idle-cycle timing and propagation behavior in the systolic array.
why_it_counts: The changed DUT file is the core PE RTL used by the systolic array.
The patch changes sequential control behavior, not just tests or documentation.
The commit message explicitly says it fixes a timing issue in the array.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes extensive test and waveform updates.
Only one DUT source line changes, so the classification relies on that logic change being the primary fix.
evidence: In `src/pe.sv`, `else begin` is changed to `else if (start) begin` in the register update block.
That change prevents `input_out` and `psum_out` from updating on cycles where `start` is low.
The rest of the commit mostly updates cocotb tests to use clock edges and refreshes waveform dumps.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a systolic or streaming MAC pipeline, a PE should only advance its forwarded input and partial sum when the stage is valid. If the PE updates those outputs every cycle, idle bubbles propagate stale or premature data and neighboring PEs consume values one cycle too early. This shows up as timing misalignment even though the arithmetic operators themselves are unchanged.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Idle or bubble cycles occur between valid matrix elements while downstream PEs still observe the forwarded signals.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the valid or start guard so the PE forwards input and partial sums every clock.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: unconditional sequential update despite invalid pipeline stage
portability_notes: Apply this at the PE boundary that forwards data to the next PE, not inside the multiplier itself.
Any equivalent stage-valid signal can be used instead of start.
The bug is timing and ordering related, so tests should include bubbles or staggered input injection.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the sequential block that latches forwarded input and accumulated sum or output.
Remove the valid or start condition guarding those updates.
Keep reset and weight-load behavior unchanged.
Exercise the array with gaps between input beats to expose the off-by-cycle propagation.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the PE from unconditional output update to else-if-start so input_out and psum_out only advance on active cycles.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change else-if-start back to unconditional else in src/pe.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Idle cycles no longer hold state; the systolic array shows cycle misalignment and incorrect accumulated outputs.
evidence_for_injection: Only the control guard on the output registers changes; the multiplier and adder remain untouched.
The bug matches the commit message timing-issue description.
Clock-edge-based tests were added, which fits a dataflow alignment fault rather than a pure arithmetic bug.
notes: This is a control-timing bug in the PE, not a fixed-point arithmetic bug.
The fault is easiest to observe when bubbles exist between valid inputs.

zh.summary: 该提交让 PE 只有在 `start` 拉高时才更新转发输入和部分和输出，从而修复了 systolic array 在空闲周期中的时序和传播行为。
why_it_counts: 被修改的 DUT 文件是 systolic array 使用的核心 PE RTL。
补丁改变的是时序控制行为，而不只是测试或文档。
提交信息明确说明是在修复阵列中的时序问题。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含大量测试和波形文件更新。
DUT 源码实际上只改了一行，因此判断主要依赖这处逻辑改动是否是核心修复。
evidence: 在 `src/pe.sv` 中，寄存器更新块里的 `else begin` 被改成了 `else if (start) begin`。
这个改动阻止了 `input_out` 和 `psum_out` 在 `start` 为低时继续更新。
其余改动主要是把 cocotb 测试改为按时钟沿驱动，并刷新了波形输出。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 systolic 或流式 MAC 流水线中，PE 只有在该级有效时才应推进前递输入和部分和。如果 PE 每个周期都更新这些输出，那么空闲 bubble 会传播陈旧或过早的数据，下游 PE 会提前一个周期消费这些值。即使乘法器和加法器本身未变，这也会表现为时序错位。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 由 valid 门控的 PE 流水线推进
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 有效矩阵元素之间存在空闲/气泡周期，而下游 PE 仍然观察前递信号。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 去掉 valid 或 start 门控，使 PE 每拍都前递输入和部分和。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在无效流水级上仍然执行无条件时序更新
portability_notes: 应在把数据前递给下一个 PE 的边界处注入，而不是改乘法器内部。
除 start 外，任何等价的 stage-valid 信号都可以作为对应注入点。
这是时序/顺序类错误，测试时应包含 bubble 或交错输入。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到锁存前递输入和累加和输出的时序寄存块。
去掉保护这些更新的 valid 或 start 条件。
保持 reset 和加载权重行为不变。
通过在输入 beat 之间加入空隙来触发并观察拍次错位。

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复把 PE 从无条件更新输出改为只在 start 有效时推进 input_out 和 psum_out。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 src/pe.sv 中把 `else if (start)` 改回无条件 `else`。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 空闲周期不再保持状态；systolic array 会出现拍次错位和累加输出错误。
evidence_for_injection: 真正改变的只有输出寄存器上的控制门，而乘法器和加法器本身没有变化。
该错误与提交信息中 timing issue 的描述一致。
新增的按时钟沿驱动测试，更符合数据流对齐故障而不是纯算术错误。
notes: 这是一类 PE 控制时序错误，而不是定点算术错误。
当有效输入之间存在 bubble 时，这个故障最容易被观察到。
